item.title: Cheerios, Pringles, Nutella among thousand of products recalled over rodent, bird waste
item.description: Thousands of products, including Cheerios, Pringles, Heinz Ketchup and Nutella, have been recalled in multiple states over possible contamination from rat and bird waste.

item.title: HS BASKETBALL: Lake-Lehman girls hand Nanticoke first league loss
item.description: Kinley Purdy scored 29 points and Delcia Biscotto added 10 to lead Lake-Lehman to a 72-54 victory over Greater Nanticoke Area in Wyoming Valley Conference girls basketball Thursday night at Lake-Lehman. The Black Knights handed the Trojanettes their first Division 2 loss of the season (11-1). Trailing by five points at the end of the first quarter, Lake-Lehman scored 26 in the second. item.title: HS SWIMMING: Kuzma sets school record in Dallas’ win
item.description: It was a record-setting day at the Dallas Natatorium on Thursday afternoon. Dallas senior diver Megan Kuzma set the school and pool record in the 1-meter event as the Mountaineers pulled away from Pittston Area, 101-69, in Wyoming Valley Conference action. Kuzma, fourth at the PIAA Class 2A meet last season, broke the record of 2024 state champ Brianne Dempsey with a score of 318.60 points. Dempsey’s record stood at 315.30. item.title: Flyers find a bumpy landing with loss in Boston
item.description: Problems with their flight from Columbus Wednesday night meant the Flyers didn’t get to bed in Boston until after 4 o'clock Thursday morning. They played like it in a 6-3 loss to the Bruins.
